test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All diaries are books.

Some bags are diaries.

**Conclusions:**

I. All bags are books.

II. Some books are bags.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3208d26317f359ce87acc9cec956e8f209b36377a49fa5323f57b7c19fd6b8cb.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All bags are books → **Does not** Follow (As all diaries are books and some bags are diaries. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. Some books are bags → Follow (As all diaries are books and some bags are diaries. So, as some part of bags is common with diaries which whole comes in books therefore it is definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows.**".
